children: Oil prices start the week higher as conflict in the Middle East spreads. Iran-backed Houthi militants have seized key territory around the strategic Bab al-Mandeb Strait. Drone attacks on the East-West pipeline, which had become a key conduit for Saudi Arabian crude to reach customers, will also constrain supply. In morning European trade, Brent crude rises 2.2% to $106.93 a barrel while WTI futures are 2.2% higher at $102.23 a barrel. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
